JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Furniture Expanded
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Furniture Expanded: about 50 vanilla-style furniture pieces with their own research.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Medical Module
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Medical: hospital furniture and linkables such as IV drips and vitals monitors.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Architect
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Architect: walls, fences, floors, carpets and bridges.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Production
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Production: powered early workbenches, tool cabinets and large double workbenches.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Security
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Security: defensive buildings for every tech level, from traps to turrets and trenches.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded: a gas network that feeds generators, heaters and workbenches.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Chemfuel Expanded: piped deepchem and chemfuel with refineries, tanks and automatic refuelling.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Nutrient Paste Expanded: piped nutrient paste with grinders, vats, taps and drip feeders.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Vanilla Psycasts Expanded
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Vanilla Psycasts Expanded: replaces Royalty psycasts with level-up paths and about 150 abilities.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Dubs Bad Hygiene
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Dubs Bad Hygiene: hygiene and bladder needs with plumbing, water, sewage, heating and cooling.

JBFramework.ModNoteDef.label: Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite
JBFramework.ModNoteDef.description: Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite: the same without thirst and water quality.
